user.title: Connect to Mealie
user.description: Mealie address and a long-lived user token (Mealie → Profile → API tokens).

init.title: Sync options
init.description: A Home Assistant list named "<prefix><Mealie list name>" is synced with that Mealie list. Webhook (POST, triggers a sync): {webhook}

data.purge_days: Remove ticked items every N days (0 = never)
data.propagate_deletes: Deleting an item in Home Assistant deletes it in Mealie

ai.title: AI enrichment (optional)
ai.description: Uses the Home Assistant `ai_task` action (the AI key stays in Home Assistant). Only empty values are filled, existing values are never changed. Runs on a schedule and with a button. Cost is capped by the limits below.

data.ai_image_entity: AI Task entity for images (empty = same)
data.ai_units: Units for list items without a unit

init.title: Choose a food
init.description: "{text}" matches several Mealie foods. Pick one; the choice is remembered.
